name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing comprehensive financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary level to enable completion of their education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students studying in Class XI, XII, undergraduate, postgraduate, or professional courses with parental annual income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh
benefits: Full compulsory non-refundable academic fees paid directly to institutions plus annual academic maintenance allowance up to Rs. 13,500 transferred directly via DBT into student bank accounts.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

source_evidence.statement: Centrally sponsored scheme implemented in 60:40 fund sharing with States (90:10 for North East).
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

source_evidence.statement: SC students studying in post-matric courses in recognized institutions whose total family income does not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

source_evidence.statement: 100% compulsory tuition and non-refundable fees reimbursement plus maintenance allowance up to Rs. 13,500/year disbursed via DBT.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

source_evidence.statement: Applications submitted on National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

source_evidence.statement: National DBT rollout covering over 60 lakh SC students annually through Aadhaar payment bridge.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Beneficiary must belong to Scheduled Caste and must not be receiving another major government scholarship.

required_documents.title: Caste Certificate
required_documents.description: Official Scheduled Caste certificate issued by competent revenue authority.

required_documents.title: Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Income certificate proving family annual income <= Rs. 2.50 lakh.

required_documents.title: Institution Bonafide Certificate
required_documents.description: Verification of admission and fee structure in recognized post-matric institution.

required_documents.title: Student Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT maintenance allowance.
